open_requests.reason: Remove or correct reason_code last_known, qualification last_known_only, and the claim that Jean-Marie Auby (1971–1975) is the best available last-known appointment. Frozen s1 revision 2560361578 has later chairperson statements claim:P488:1 through :8, including preferred-rank Q105337110 with 2012–2013 dates. Retain Auby as a supported historical observation with an honest selection rationale, or select a later supported observation using only the prepared evidence; do not fabricate a person name from an unresolved QID.

The inaccurate last_known selection and last_known_only qualification are gone, but the revision deletes leadership.chair entirely. The request explicitly also required retaining Auby as a supported historical observation with an honest rationale or selecting a later supported chair observation; neither is present. Dean Lewis in the separate undated president field does not preserve the requested dated P488 observation. Frozen s1 P488:0 and s12 support Auby (1971–1975), and P488:8 supports Q105337110 (2012–2013), without needing an invented name.
